summary: Tested FitStudio AI end-to-end. Backend: 24/24 pytest tests passed (auth, register, studios, exercises, classes pipeline w/ real LLM script + mocked voice/avatar/render, admin, tenant isolation). Frontend: landing, owner login, sidebar nav (4 links), exercise library (26 cards, search filters), branding save, class creation + pipeline completion (status reached RENDERED in ~10s, 10 segments populated with voice_script/breath/safety/coaching), and SUPER_ADMIN-only nav visibility all working. Pipeline ran with Emergent LLM successfully end-to-end.

integration_issues.issue: Console shows two `400 Bad Request` AxiosErrors on /app/classes/:id detail page (likely a continued poll/PATCH after pipeline completion). Page still renders correctly with full pipeline + segments, but the spurious 400s trigger the webpack-dev-server error overlay in dev mode which can intercept subsequent clicks. Not visible in production build but should be investigated (likely a stale PATCH or polling call).

action_items: Investigate the 400 errors fired from the ClassDetail page after status reaches RENDERED — likely a polling call or refreshUser that should stop once status is terminal. The webpack overlay it triggers blocks pointer events in dev preview.
(Optional) Surface a 'Hello, <first_name>' on the dashboard heading — currently confirmed working for Maya.
critical_code_review_comments: classes/views.py PATCH `script_json` is allowed unconditionally for any studio member — fine for OWNER/TRAINER but no role-restriction. Acceptable for Phase 1.

exercises/views.py POST does not check role (OWNER/SUPER_ADMIN) before allowing studio-exercise creation — anyone authenticated in the studio (incl. TRAINER) can create. Test request was for OWNER only; behavior is more permissive than spec. Low priority.
Pipeline runs in a daemon thread; on container restart any in-flight class would be stuck in SCRIPTING. Document or move to a task queue for production.
Frontend stores JWT in localStorage (visible via api.js) — XSS risk; acceptable for POC.
Class detail page polling does not back off or stop on terminal status (root cause of the 400 spam).

success_rate.frontend: 95% (7/7 critical flows visually + functionally verified; admin page navigation blocked by dev-mode webpack overlay caused by class-detail 400s — admin conditional rendering itself confirmed working)

test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md as-is. Owner: owner@lumen.studio/Owner@12345; Super Admin: admin@fitstudio.ai/Admin@12345
seed_data_creation: Created via tests (auto-cleaned-up via TEST_ prefix where applicable): TEST exercise, TEST class with full pipeline run, ~3 throwaway studios via /api/auth/register for tenant-isolation testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend ships as Django ASGI via uvicorn on 8001. Pipeline uses real Emergent LLM for script and mocked voice/avatar/render — end-to-end completes in ~10s. /api/exercises/ POST requires `instructions` field. /api/classes/ GET trailing slash matters (uses '' route). Class detail page emits two 400s after RENDERED — review_request author should silence the spurious polling call.
rca of the issue: ClassDetail page 400 errors: Likely the auto-polling effect continues firing after status becomes RENDERED, hitting an endpoint whose payload is now invalid (or an unconditional PATCH). Reproduction: log in as owner, create a class, wait ~10s for RENDERED, watch browser DevTools network — two requests return 400. Mitigation: stop the polling interval (clearInterval) when status ∈ {RENDERED, FAILED}.
